title: Background Sync
definition: Background Sync is a web API that defers actions until the user has stable connectivity. If a user sends a chat message while offline, the service worker saves the action and automatically sends it the moment the connection is restored, even if the user closed the tab.
simpleExplanation: You hit 'Send' while in a tunnel. You close the app. The second your phone gets a signal, the app secretly sends the message in the background.
